findings.source: ComptrollerLegacy.sol:1290 Exp({mantissa: cToken.borrowIndex()}) inside for (i < cTokens.length)
findings.issue: The GAS reading of the first (peeled) iteration is reused as the gas operand of the borrowIndex call in every later iteration; the bytecode executes GAS right before each STATICCALL (checked in the disassembly), so the text states a stale gas amount. No effect on execution after EIP-150 (both values exceed the 63/64 cap), but the rule that produced it would be wrong for any loop that tests gasleft().
findings.rule: GAS is not a pure expression: every GAS instruction yields a new value, so it must never be merged or carried as a loop-invariant variable across iterations or duplicated blocks.
findings.verified: reading only + disassembly (each borrowIndex site is 'gas staticcall')

Checked and faithful: exitMarket's revert at 2017 shows ext_call.return_data[105 len 23] in the padding because the message is CODECOPYed with length 37 over the return data (disassembly 0x3bfb); 'assert not membership' in borrowAllowed's not-member branch is exact. P3 = 17 storage-to-memory array copies + 6 struct-array allocation loops; P7 = 279 revert-string copies; constants compInitialIndex printed as 1000000000000000000 * 10**18 (154 lines) and 0.9e18 as 25 * 10**13 * 3600 (P1); scratch save/restore around the codecopy of string literals (_217 = mem[0]; mem[0] = 'block number...'; mem[0] = _217) counted in P8.
